# Contributor Authorship and Intellectual Property Declaration Template

**Document Status:** Unsigned Template  
**Purpose:** Form for individual dictionary contributors to formally declare independent authorship and certify intellectual property chain-of-title for LingoPDF's authored dictionary.  
**Notice:** *This template is an administrative declaration form and is not a substitute for formal legal advice or a binding Copyright Assignment Agreement executed under applicable jurisdiction law.*

## 3. Declaration of Independent Authorship

I hereby declare and represent under penalty of perjury (or under applicable national law):

1. **Independent Creation:**  
   All German headwords, English translations, contextual sense disambiguations, grammatical annotations, inflection mappings, and compound breakdowns submitted by me were independently authored by me using my own linguistic knowledge, skill, and judgment.

2. **No Verbatim Copying:**  
   I have not copied, scraped, extracted, or adapted verbatim text, descriptive definitions, or proprietary translations from any commercial bilingual or monolingual dictionary (including, but not limited to, Duden, PONS, Langenscheidt, Oxford-Duden, Collins, Cambridge, or Leo).

3. **No Unlicensed Third-Party Datasets:**  
   No part of my contribution was generated, ingested, or adapted from copyleft datasets (such as English or German Wiktionary, Kaikki.org, FreeDict, or OpenThesaurus) or from proprietary web APIs without explicit written authorization.

4. **Reference Materials Consulted:**  
   To the extent that I consulted external reference works (such as grammar reference books, frequency corpora, or language-learning textbooks) during the preparation of entries, such consultation was strictly limited to verifying objective grammatical facts (e.g. grammatical gender, plural formation, principal verb parts) and factual frequency rankings. The expression, selection, and formatting of entries remain original.

## 4. Assignment / Transfer of Intellectual Property Rights

*(Select the applicable statement based on your legal relationship):*

- [ ] **Work Made for Hire (Employment):**  
  I created all contributions within the scope of my employment with the operating entity, and all copyright, database rights, and intellectual property rights automatically vest in the company as work made for hire.

- [ ] **Contractor Assignment:**  
  I created these contributions as an independent contractor pursuant to a written services agreement under which I have assigned (or hereby assign) all right, title, and interest, including all copyright and database rights, to the operating entity and its successors.

- [ ] **Direct Assignment / Quitclaim:**  
  To the extent that any intellectual property rights did not automatically vest in the operating entity, I hereby irrevocably assign, transfer, and convey to the operating entity all worldwide right, title, and interest in and to my contributions, including all copyright, database rights, and related rights for commercial distribution.

- [ ] **Moral Rights Waiver:**  
  To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, I waive (or agree not to assert against the operating entity, its licensees, or customers) any moral rights, rights of attribution, or integrity rights in my contributions.
